version_note: V3.1.5: conserva barrenos PTH <25 mm y fuerza cut_outer desde Y_DXF mínimo, con X_DXF máximo como desempate.
main_changes: Preserved the complete 240x96 geometry, normalization, ordering and entry methodology.
Forced robot_programming.robot=3 independently from source DXF scene metadata.
Changed the official DXF reader default calibrated scene to L3.
Added R3_B_240X96_E1_J2_V1.json with the 25 supplied 5x5 measurements.
Changed active policy IDs and motion-map metadata from R4 to R3.
Kept normalization margin at 20 mm, column band at 100 mm and individual hole E1_fixed logic.
Decoupled detected PLATE/bbox dimensions from the fixed 6096x2438 programming envelope.
Allows smaller or nonstandard source plate sizes when the useful normalized nesting fits the 240x96 envelope.
Reports detected nesting size and source in LS-ready JSON and generator report.
Keeps hard rejection for normalized geometry outside 6096x2438.
Circular holes with diameter under 25 mm use 10 CNT40 PTH to the first cut point, 10 CNT60 PTH on arc 1, and 7 CNT40 PTH on arc 2.
Circular holes with diameter 25 mm or greater keep the standard 35 mm/sec, CNT50, FINE profile.
All linear hole motions omit COORD because every hole path uses a fixed E1 value.
Outer cut entry now prioritizes minimum Y_DXF and uses maximum X_DXF only as a tie-breaker, preventing the equivalent diagonal-side start at mid-height.
